name: University of Calgary
summary: Founded 1966: about 38,000 students on four campuses in Calgary, with Schulich engineering, Haskayne business and co-op or internship options.

ib.text: Full IB Diploma with three HL and no grade below 3; TOK, EE and CAS count in the total. Five program courses required; estimated competitive scores run 24-25 for Arts to 33-34 for Engineering.

dates.label: International application opens: students requiring a study permit
Unofficial transcripts and supporting documents due
Residence Guarantee: high school applicants' application deadline

programmes.name: Engineering (common first year)
programmes.about: Everyone starts with the same 10 design, maths, science and engineering courses in Schulich School of Engineering, then ranks majors in winter term; first choice of program is guaranteed if you complete all ten. Paid career practicum and internship options.
programmes.ib: English, Mathematics (also counts as Calculus), Chemistry and Physics or Biology; Maths AI is accepted. Estimated competitive diploma score 33-34.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on the diploma score from predicted, then final, IB results; 33-34 is last year's estimated competitive range, not a published minimum for 2027.

flagshipSource.title: Engineering (common first year): ten common-core courses, guaranteed program choice and paid placements

programmes.name: Commerce (Haskayne School of Business)
programmes.about: A four-year business degree entered directly from school, with an optional Co-operative Education stream, an Honours research option and more than 30 exchange partners. Haskayne has held AACSB accreditation since 1985.
programmes.ib: English, Mathematics, two approved courses (not PE, fine arts or non-calculus maths) and one more approved course; Maths AI is accepted. Estimated competitive score 27-30.
programmes.selectionNote: Places are capped by a quota and ranked on the diploma score; meeting the minimum does not guarantee admission, and the competitive range moves each year.

flagshipSource.title: Haskayne BComm: Co-operative Education, over 30 exchange partners, AACSB accredited since 1985

faculties.name: Schulich School of Engineering
faculties.line: English, Maths, Calculus, Chemistry and Physics or Biology; estimated competitive diploma score 33-34; common first year.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science
faculties.line: English, Maths and one or two sciences; competitive 27-30 for most programs, 33-42 for biology, neuroscience and biochemistry.

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts
faculties.line: English and four approved courses; competitive 24-25 for most, 33-34 for Psychology; Dance, Music, Visual Studies add auditions.

faculties.name: Haskayne School of Business
faculties.line: A quota limits places; admission is competitive and the minimum does not guarantee a place. Estimated competitive IB score 27-30.

faculties.name: Cumming School of Medicine (Health Sciences)
faculties.line: Health Sciences: English, Maths (minimum 4), Chemistry, Biology; competitive 33-34 and an online supplementary application.

faculties.name: Faculty of Kinesiology
faculties.line: English, Maths, Chemistry and Biology; estimated competitive score 30-33; Physics is recommended.

faculties.name: Faculty of Nursing
faculties.line: English, Maths, Chemistry and Biology; estimated competitive score 29; admission uses a lottery.

faculties.name: Werklund School of Education
faculties.line: Estimated competitive scores of 27-34 depending on the program and teachable subject area.

faculties.name: School of Architecture, Planning and Landscape
faculties.line: English, Maths, one of Physics, Chemistry or Biology and two approved courses; estimated competitive score 27-30.

faculties.name: Faculty of Social Work
faculties.line: English and four approved courses; estimated competitive score 27-30.

notes: Completing the IB Diploma can earn up to a full year (30 units) of first-year credit.
UCalgary assesses the initial application on predicted IB grades; official final IB transcripts are required to finalize an offer.
International tuition is charged per 3-unit course (CAD 3,078 in most faculties, 3,610 in Haskayne, 4,149 in Schulich), so a 10-course year costs ten times that.
